topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I heard that you, little one, would be in Mr. Bennett's class, the news felt like a stone in my stomach. I can't shake the memories that come with his name, the way the air felt thick and heavy in his classroom. I want only good things for you, and the thought of you facing even a shadow of what I did... It makes me want to scoop you up and keep you safe, away from it all. But you're brave, stronger than I ever was, and I must trust in that strength, believing it will guard you better than I ever could.
